about: A task queue for Django that runs background and scheduled jobs.

prs.title: Monthly schedules keep their day east of UTC
prs.broken: Monthly and yearly jobs in time zones ahead of UTC counted months from the wrong day, so a job on the 1st slid to the 29th after February and stayed there.
prs.changed: Month and year steps now use the local date.
prs.matters: Scheduled jobs keep running on the day people set them for.
